changes.summary: Added the statutory temporary continuation of Salvadoran TPS while preserving that DHS has not issued a final country determination.
Added Trump's conditional $5,000 payment proposal without treating it as enacted, funded, authorized or payable.
Added the September 8 nonlethal interdiction and September 9 lethal strike with source-attribution and verification limits.
Added the NTSB cockpit-recording sequence while preserving the ongoing investigation and absence of probable cause.
